start.observation: An ordinary center-screen tap left the home screen, and a second tap launched the saucer into active flight.

agency.normalInput: Repeated center-screen taps at the flight cadence.
agency.controlCondition: The same-duration run with zero input.
agency.observation: The tapped run repeatedly changed the saucer's vertical velocity and advanced through the gate corridor, while the zero-input run did not reproduce that flight path.

restart.observation: A collision reached the stable end state; an ordinary tap returned to ready, and the next tap launched a second playable run.

start.observation: An ordinary center-screen tap left the finished home screen, and a second tap launched the final saucer into active flight.

agency.normalInput: Repeated center-screen taps at the flight cadence.
agency.controlCondition: The same-duration final build with zero input.
agency.observation: All three supported-surface tape checks showed visible tap-driven flight that differed from their zero-input controls.

restart.observation: The final build reached a collision, accepted an ordinary restart tap, and launched a second playable run with the HUD and pause control active.
